We have spotted Koala in this park in previous months as well as in the past week. Yesterday,  at the time noted, koala ran across Byng Road which is a busy road.

So, as I was leaving Birkdale School of Arts Hall, I saw a koala crossing from near Birkdale Green Medical Centre across 4 lanes of Birkdale Road, heading toward the Mobile Home (Gateway Lifestyle) Village.  I pulled over my car and found the specimen climbing up a small eucalypt and it remained at about head height for around 5 minutes as I was chatting to the creature.It looked really healthy, clean, full pelt, no signs of cystitis, and while I tried to take video, it was too dark to see the koala. I apologised for using flash but it was quite understanding... saw another koala within the Birkdale State School grounds around a year ago.Very special to know they still use the area to traverse & range.Lucky there was no traffic to cause injury...Thanks for this service.
